symptom: `run --local --watch` on Mendix 11.12.5: the first hot reload after a model change (one new microflow) reports "applied: build #2 via reload in 4.3s" but leaves deployment/web/dist holding only index.js and chunks/ — no pages/, no widgets.css — so every page fails with "An error occurred while loading page" until the loop restarts. A page edit in the same state FAILS instead, with "Could not find a part of the path '…/web/pages/<Page>.js'"
cause: mxbuild --serve in the prebuilt shape (mxbuild writes web/dist itself): only the FIRST build in a serve process bundles completely; it leaves no web/pages, web/layouts or bundler config for its own incremental builds. Every later build replaces dist with a 683 KB monolithic index.js + one chunk (a non-page change, or NO change) or fails (a page change). mxcli's existing guards could not see it: ensureClientServed probes index.js and its static imports (both fine), and missingPageChunks needs web/pages source, which the prebuilt shape never has
insight: Settled by driving mxbuild's /build API from a 40-line harness, no watch loop: cold → 13 pages/5.6 KB index.js; second build, model UNCHANGED → 0 pages/683 KB; after rm web/dist → same; after rm web/ → Failure; fresh process → complete. The unchanged-model row is what rules out 'something in the change' and every deployment-side repair at once. A fresh process's first build reports restartRequired=true even for an unchanged model, so recovery keeps the INCREMENTAL build's answer — otherwise each change would restart the runtime and drop sessions. The wrong turn to skip: snapshot-and-restore of the old dist. The incomplete build's index.js is a different bundle (different chunk hashes), so restoring old pages/chunks next to it mixes two module graphs. This is the same defect the 11.14 hint in webclient_legacy_paths.go described as 'nothing outside the process fixes it' — true of the deployment, false of the process; that hint now only prints if the fresh process fails too. Controls: pre-fix binary on the same app → dist = chunks index.js, `mxcli playwright check` FAIL (error banner, 2 console errors, 2 failed requests); fixed → reload in ~29s, 13 pages, check OK, and a page edit (previously a hard failure) applies with the new title in the chunk
